enrich.rationale: Residual-UCB active learning will concentrate new solves in the specific input directions where the current winner is measurably weak, improving accuracy faster than blind resampling or additional hyperparameter search.

diagnosis: RMSE is still sample-bottlenecked with structured, input-correlated residuals (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip), while split variance is low so targeted new samples should translate into real RMSE gains.
